note: Values are DynastyProcess Superflex values as of 2026-11-16; picks priced by the original team's projected 2027 slot from current standings (early, mid, late third), flat the year after, then 15% off per further year. PPG is this season through week 6, games with points only. ST marks a startable average (QB 14, RB 9, WR 9, TE 7). SELL and HOLD tags on your roster are the ledger from the brief. P/V is production vs price: a player's rank at his position by PPG against his rank by value, among rostered players with 4+ games (+ produces better than priced). BUY LOW: under the position's sell age (QB 30, RB 25, WR 27, TE 28), startable, producing at least twice as well as priced. SELL HIGH: at or past the sell age, priced at least twice as well as producing, worth 900+, not on IR.
reasons: thin depth (18th percentile) on a roster ranked 12th in total value
core age 23.6: young enough that the rebuild should be short
